TestTracingReadAccess::test_tracing_info.reason: Would be GREEN (unique coverage of live sstable-read tracing, no scylla test) but the test cannot fail. no-op since 047420a3 (PR 1818, 2020-12-15; before that, 'Reading partition range' regex had no '|' and was a real check). Bug: all 3 regexes in _verify_tracing_info (cql_tracing_addition_test.py:188-191) end in unescaped '| {addr} |' -> top-level alternation with an empty alternative, so PytestRegex (re.match) always returns True; verified empirically. The test cannot fail on missing trace output; 32/32 pass in next_gating is meaningless. Note: even with '|' escaped, PytestRegex uses re.match (anchored at pos 0, no DOTALL) vs old assertRegexpMatches (re.search) since pytest port fa0e7515 — cqlsh output never starts with 'Reading ...', so naive fix fails; needs re.search or rewrite via driver trace=True + system_traces.events. Note: d22c82e604 (PR 6887, cqlsh-rs) removed 'assert not err' from all run_cqlsh helpers, the only remaining real check; unverified whether cqlsh-rs prints TRACING output the same way. Note: sstable path interpolated into regex unescaped (:188-190).
